tagline.en: The Kansas City belt, twenty-two years in the building
tagline.zh: 堪萨斯城环线：修了二十二年

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

en: I-435 is the full circle around Kansas City, and because the metropolitan area straddles a state line the loop does too: 52.75 miles in Missouri and 27.99 in Kansas. It crosses the Missouri River twice and the Kansas River once, passes the west side of Kansas City International Airport, and touches Overland Park, Lenexa, Leawood, Shawnee, Grandview, Raytown, Independence and Gladstone on the way round.

The even hundreds digit marks a loop off I-35, and it is one, though most of the traffic on it is local. On the south side, between the state line and the interchange with I-49 and US 71, MoDOT reports that I-435 carries the highest volume of any facility it operates in Kansas City and the second highest in the metropolitan area. That section opened in 1966 as a six-lane freeway; a seventh lane was added in phases between 1983 and 1994, and it has otherwise been left much as it was built.
zh: I-435 是围绕堪萨斯城的一整圈环线；由于该都会区横跨州界，这条环线也横跨州界：密苏里州 52.75 英里，堪萨斯州 27.99 英里。它两次跨越密苏里河、一次跨越堪萨斯河，经过堪萨斯城国际机场西侧，沿途途经奥弗兰帕克、勒内克萨、利伍德、肖尼、格兰德维尤、雷敦、独立城与格拉德斯通。
偶数百位标示它是从 I-35 分出的环线，事实也是如此，不过路上多数车流是本地交通。在南侧、州界与 I-49／US 71 枢纽之间，密苏里州交通部称 I-435 的交通量高于它在堪萨斯城运营的任何设施，在整个都会区居第二。该段 1966 年以六车道高速通车；1983 至 1994 年间分期加铺了第七条车道，此外基本维持建成时的样子。

en: It was built piece by piece over two decades. Two disconnected segments opened in 1965 — one between I-35 and US 69 near Overland Park, one between I-70 and US 50 in eastern Kansas City — and the gap between them was closed by 1969. AASHO formally designated the Kansas City beltway as I-435 on 23 June 1969. The road reached across the Missouri River to Claycomo in 1973, which put it halfway round the city, and the north-west and western legs followed in the 1980s. The circle closed in 1987.

Most of the money spent on it since has gone into interchanges. The Johnson County Gateway project, where the belt meets I-35 and K-10 at Lenexa, was estimated at $600 million across three phases, with the second running from spring 2014 to January 2017. A $102 million rebuild of the I-435/US 69 interchange ran from July 2011 to November 2013, and an earlier $165 million programme through Overland Park finished in December 2008.
zh: 这条路是分块建成的，历时二十年。1965 年通车的是两段互不相连的路：一段在奥弗兰帕克附近的 I-35 与 US 69 之间，一段在东堪萨斯城的 I-70 与 US 50 之间；两者之间的缺口到 1969 年才补上。1969 年 6 月 23 日，美国州公路工作者协会正式把堪萨斯城环线定名为 I-435。1973 年，这条路跨过密苏里河抵达克莱科莫，至此绕过了城市的一半；西北段与西段在 1980 年代陆续建成。环线于 1987 年合圈。
此后花在它身上的钱多数投入了立交。环线在勒内克萨与 I-35、K-10 相交处的「约翰逊县门户」工程，三期估算共 6 亿美元，其中第二期自 2014 年春持续到 2017 年 1 月。I-435 与 US 69 立交的重建耗资 1.02 亿美元，工期自 2011 年 7 月至 2013 年 11 月；更早一轮贯穿奥弗兰帕克的 1.65 亿美元工程于 2008 年 12 月完工。

why.en: The beltway was built in separate segments by two state highway departments between 1965 and 1987 and neither Missouri nor Kansas publishes a cumulative construction total for it.
why.zh: 这条环线由两个州的公路部门在 1965 至 1987 年间分段建成，密苏里州与堪萨斯州均未公布其累计建设总额。

value.en: The south corridor carries the highest volume of any MoDOT facility in Kansas City and the second highest in the metropolitan area, behind I-35 north of US 69 in Kansas
value.zh: 南段走廊的交通量在密苏里州交通部于堪萨斯城运营的设施中最高，在整个都会区仅次于堪萨斯州境内 US 69 以北的 I-35

trafficFigures.source: Missouri Department of Transportation, I-435 South Corridor study

timeline.en: Two disconnected segments open, one in Kansas and one in Missouri.
timeline.zh: 两段互不相连的路通车，分别位于堪萨斯州与密苏里州。

timeline.en: AASHO designates the Kansas City beltway as I-435 on 23 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 23 日，美国州公路工作者协会将堪萨斯城环线定名为 I-435。

timeline.en: The road crosses the Missouri River to Claycomo, reaching halfway around the city.
timeline.zh: 道路跨越密苏里河抵达克莱科莫，绕城过半。

timeline.en: The loop is opened all the way around Kansas City.
timeline.zh: 环线绕堪萨斯城全线贯通。
